data.interpretation: The KPI asks to minimize road-rule violations (release deadline overruns and blocking_guard evictions), which maps directly to road_violations. 'Make sure the road rules are kept' can be read as zero violations, while 'as much as possible' suggests minimizing without a fixed level. The KPI states no delivery or waiting-time levels, so those metrics are watched for worsening but have no targets or guards.

options.label: Minimize road violations, no fixed level

goals.text: Reduce road-rule violations as much as possible.
Watch that time robots spend blocked by stopped robots does not grow, which would mean the rules were relaxed rather than kept.
Watch that on-time deliveries do not fall because robots avoid the road to avoid violations.
Watch that undelivered orders at period end do not grow.

options.note: Improvement is measured only on road_violations. No achievement level is set because 'as much as possible' gives none.

options.label: Zero road violations as the achievement level

goals.text: Make sure the road rules are kept: zero road-rule violations counts as achieved, and fewer is better until then.
Watch that time robots spend blocked by stopped robots does not grow, which would mean the rules were relaxed rather than kept.
Watch that on-time deliveries do not fall because robots avoid the road to avoid violations.
Watch that undelivered orders at period end do not grow.

options.note: Reads 'make sure the road rules are kept' as a zero-violation target. Zero is used as a target rather than a guard, so amendments that reduce violations without reaching zero can still be adopted.

concerns: road_violations is a proxy for safe, orderly road use. Since ROAD_USE itself can be amended, violations could be cut by loosening release deadlines or blocking_guard rules instead of improving behavior. blocked_s is monitored to catch this, but you may want to state explicitly whether relaxing the rules is acceptable.

Violations could also fall if robots simply use the road less, which would hurt deliveries. The KPI gives no delivery or waiting-time level, so these are only monitored, not guarded. If you have a minimum level (for example an on-time rate), please state it so it can become a guard.
It is unclear whether 'make sure the road rules are kept' means zero violations (option 2) or only as few as possible (option 1).
